title: Denial-of-service FSM Trojan in a bus arbiter
objective: Review the provided RTL bus-arbiter design and produce a structured analysis report describing the design's finite-state behavior, identifying any state(s) that could cause the arbiter to stop granting bus access to legitimate masters, and the exact request sequence that reaches such a state.

expected_outputs.summary: A JSON report at submission/trojan_report.json listing candidate anomalous FSM states/transitions with confidence scores and rationale grounded in the actual RTL, plus an explicit overall_assessment of whether a permanent denial-of-service condition exists in the arbiter's state machine, and a recommended_fix.

schema.candidates: non-empty array of {state_name, trigger_condition, confidence (0.0-1.0), rationale, impact}
schema.overall_assessment: string explicitly answering the liveness/DoS question with justification
schema.recommended_fix: string describing remediation or stating none is needed

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of hidden security requirements about the correct sink state, trigger pattern/origin, and DoS assessment that the submitted report satisfies.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of reported candidate states/transitions that do not correspond to the actual hidden lock state/trigger, out of all reported candidates.

metrics.name: trigger_payload_localization
metrics.description: Accuracy score measuring how precisely the reported trigger_condition matches the true triggering request pattern and originating state.
